data.description: Where Tradition Meets Modern Luxury – Live the Old Town Island Lifestyle

data.answer:
Old Town Island Dubai offers an exclusive blend of urban sophistication and tranquil living, right in the heart of Downtown Dubai. 

The Old Town Island community enjoys top-tier amenities, including swimming pools, landscaped gardens, children’s play areas, and cutting-edge fitness centers. Safety is a priority, with 24/7 surveillance throughout the area. With spacious layouts, elegant interiors, and breathtaking skyline views, the Old Town Apartments Dubai reflects luxury living at its finest.

The Old Town Island Dubai presents various residential options, including 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and 3-bedroom villas. Apartment sizes range from 958 to 4,345 sq. ft., ensuring ample space for comfortable living. Some units feature private balconies or gardens. For those seeking expansive homes, the 3-bedroom villas provide approximately 3,826 sq. ft. of luxury living space.

Popular Buildings in Old Town Island

Al Tajer Residences, a 7-story building next to Souk Al Bahar, offers easy access to Downtown Dubai’s retail and dining attractions, featuring 1 to 3-bedroom apartments with luxurious interiors. 

Attareen Residences, a 5-story building, presents a variety of homes, from apartments to villas, offering residents a blend of serene living and convenient access to the vibrant Old Town Island Dubai location. 

Al Saaha Offices, a commercial complex of four 7-story buildings, provides modern office spaces with excellent visibility and connectivity in Downtown Dubai.

Renting a Property in Old Town Island

Those looking to rent properties in Dubai will find various options in Old Town Island. Annual rental prices for 1-bedroom apartments range from AED 130k to AED 320k. Families or groups may choose 2-bedroom apartments, typically priced between AED 220k and AED 350k annually. 

For those seeking luxury, 3-bedroom apartments are available with annual rents ranging from AED 339k to AED 650k, ensuring a sophisticated living experience. 

Buying a Property in Old Town Island

Old Town Island offers a good opportunity to invest in properties for sale in Dubai. 1-bedroom apartments are priced between AED 2.7M and AED 5M, while 2-bedroom apartments range from AED 3.6M to AED 9.8M. 

Spacious 3-bedroom apartments are available from AED 7.75M to AED 16.5M, with 4-bedroom apartments priced around AED 14.3 M. For larger families, 3-bedroom villas are available for approximately AED 16.5M. Commercial spaces are available between AED 12M and AED 24M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Old Town Island?

data.answer:
Living in Old Town Island offers a unique lifestyle combining urban luxury and serenity. Located in the heart of Downtown Dubai, residents enjoy seamless access to premium shopping and entertainment at Dubai Mall and Souk Al Bahar. 

The Old Town Island Dubai community features numerous amenities such as swimming pools, gyms, and landscaped gardens, creating a vibrant environment for relaxation and recreation.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Old Town Island

The Old Town Island Dubai location offers excellent connectivity to key areas of the city. Residents can reach the Burj Khalifa/Downtown Dubai Metro Station and Dubai Mall Bus Stop within a 10-minute drive. 

Major highways like Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) and Al Khail Road (E44) are easily accessible, providing smooth access to various parts of the city. All buildings offer covered parking spaces, ensuring convenience for residents.

Supermarkets in Old Town Island

Residents of Old Town Island enjoy easy access to supermarkets for daily essentials. Grandiose Supermarket, located in Souk Al Bahar, provides a variety of fresh produce and gourmet items. Carrefour Market and Spinneys are also nearby, offering a comprehensive selection of groceries and household products within a short drive.

Shopping Mall in Old Town Island Dubai

Living in Old Town Island places residents at the center of a shopping paradise. Souk Al Bahar offers a mix of traditional Arabian charm and modern retail. 

The nearby Dubai Mall provides an extensive selection of international brands, high-end boutiques, and entertainment, including dining, cinemas, and family attractions, elevating the experience of Old Town Island luxury living.

Schools and Nurseries in the Old Town Island Area

Blossom Children’s Nursery, located just a 5-minute drive from Old Town Island, offers early education for children aged 3 months to 4 years. 

Families with older children can consider Citizens School in Al Satwa, approximately a 13-minute drive away, which provides a British curriculum with strong academics and extracurricular activities from FS1 to Year 8.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near Old Town Island Location

Old Town Island Dubai fosters a multicultural community with access to several places of worship. Mosques such as the Grand Mosque and Jumeirah Mosque are located within a 15-20 minute drive. 

For Hindu residents, the Shiva and Hare Krishna Temples in Bur Dubai are also approximately 20 minutes away. 
Christian residents have access to St. Mary’s Catholic Church and the Anglican Church of All Saints, both within a 20 to 25-minute drive.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near Old Town Island Area

Residents of Old Town Island have access to healthcare facilities nearby. Sage Clinics and Aster Royal Clinic Downtown are both within an 8-minute drive, offering general and specialized services. 

For advanced care, Medcare Hospital and American Hospital Dubai are available within a 20-30 minute drive, ensuring access to quality healthcare.

Old Town Island Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Old Town Island is strategically located within Downtown Dubai, surrounded by Business Bay, DIFC, and Al Wasl. You only need to look at the Old Town Island Dubai location map to find that Burj Khalifa, Dubai Opera, and other major attractions are close by.

more_info.question: Things to Do in the Old Town Island Area

data.answer:
Old Town Island offers a dynamic lifestyle with access to world-class shopping, waterfront promenades, and a variety of dining options. From the authentic Lebanese cuisine at Othman’s Lounge to Indian flavors at Maison De Curry, residents can enjoy diverse culinary experiences. For nightlife, The Irish Vicker’s and The Tap House Downtown provide vibrant settings for socializing.

Beaches Near Old Town Island

Residents can reach Jumeirah Public Beach and La Mer Beach within a 22-minute drive. These popular coastal destinations offer opportunities for swimming, water sports, and relaxation, providing a refreshing escape from the city.

Hotels in the Old Town Island Area

Visitors and residents seeking luxurious accommodation can stay at nearby hotels such as the Palace Downtown and Address Downtown. These prestigious hotels offer world-class services, stunning views, and convenient access to the attractions of Downtown Dubai.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Old Town Island offers a range of outdoor activities and wellness options. Waterfront promenades provide a peaceful setting for walks and jogs. Residents can stay active at the gyms located within the community, while nearby spas and salons offer beauty and relaxation treatments to suit every preference.

Old Town Island Attractions and Landmarks

The Dubai Mall, located just 8 minutes away, provides an unparalleled shopping and entertainment experience. 
Dubai Opera, a world-class cultural venue, is a 6-minute drive from Old Town Island Downtown Dubai. 
The Burj Khalifa, the world’s tallest tower, is just 7 minutes away, offering stunning views of the Dubai skyline from its observation deck.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms and Salons

Old Town Island, Dubai, offers a vibrant outdoor lifestyle. Residents can enjoy waterfront strolls, water sports, and a state-of-the-art gym. Nearby salons cater to both men and women.

Old Town Island offers luxurious living in a prime location, but it is important to consider property prices and maintenance costs when investing. Its unique blend of urban convenience and serene surroundings makes it a highly desirable community in the heart of Dubai.

What makes Old Town Island an attractive place to live?

Old Town Island offers a luxurious and convenient lifestyle in the heart of Dubai. With its prime location near the Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and other major attractions, residents enjoy unparalleled access to world-class amenities and entertainment options. The community is known for its elegant properties, modern conveniences, and serene environment, making it ideal for those seeking a high-quality living experience.

The Old Town Island Dubai community features a range of residential properties, including 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, along with spacious 3-bedroom villas. Designed with elegance and comfort in mind, these homes offer modern interiors, expansive layouts, and scenic views, catering to individuals, families, and investors alike.

What amenities can residents enjoy in Old Town Island?

Residents of Old Town Island Dubai Downtown have access to a variety of amenities, including swimming pools, landscaped gardens, children’s play areas, and state-of-the-art fitness centers. The community also prioritizes security, with 24/7 surveillance, ensuring a safe and comfortable living environment for all residents.

How well-connected is Old Town Island to the rest of Dubai?

The Old Town Island Dubai location offers excellent connectivity. The Burj Khalifa/Downtown Dubai Metro Station is a short drive away, providing direct access to key areas of the city. In addition, major highways like Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road are easily accessible, ensuring convenient travel throughout Dubai.

What attractions and activities are near Old Town Island?

Living in Old Town Island puts residents at the heart of Dubai’s vibrant lifestyle. The Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai Opera are all within proximity, offering endless opportunities for shopping, entertainment, and cultural experiences. Residents can also enjoy the unique charm of Souk Al Bahar, waterfront promenades, and an array of fine dining and nightlife options nearby.

data.content:
Old Town Island is a prestigious residential and commercial development by Emaar Properties, situated in Downtown Dubai. Located near the iconic Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, Old Town Island Downtown Dubai offers unparalleled access to world-class shopping, dining, and entertainment. 

Those interested in Old Town apartments in Dubai can choose from 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom units along with luxurious 3-bedroom villas. These properties are designed to deliver comfort, modern convenience, and a high standard of living.

Old Town Island combines traditional Arabian architecture with modern amenities, creating a unique and immersive lifestyle experience in the heart of Dubai. Residents are surrounded by lush landscapes, serene walkways, and charming courtyards that add to the community's inviting ambiance. With easy access to Downtown’s vibrant attractions yet nestled within a peaceful enclave, Old Town Island offers an ideal blend of luxury and tranquility for discerning residents seeking an exclusive address.
